$comment: Source of truth for the Iron Lung presets. Edit this file and run 'make presets' to regenerate plugins/IronLung/Presets.hpp (DPF programs, exported to LV2 presets.ttl/manifest.ttl and to VST3/CLAP). The parameter order below must match the Parameters enum in DistrhoPluginInfo.h (level, tone, attack, sustain, vca); program 0 must equal 'defaults'.

presets.name: Manual - as a compressor (LEVEL 10:00, TONE 1:30, ATTACK 11:00)
Manual - as a limiter (SUSTAIN 10:00)
presets.source: BOSS owner's manual, as a limiter

presets.name: Always-on, subtle (BOSS article: attack/sustain at 12)
presets.source: BOSS Pedal Partners article: attack and sustain at 12 o'clock

presets.name: Clean and open (reviewer: sustain 9:00, tone 1:00)
presets.source: Ovnilab review: sustain near minimum, tone flat near 1:00

presets.name: Country snap (pick attack forward)
presets.source: Guitar Chalk setting guide (a guide's suggestion, not an artist's)

presets.name: Infinite sustain lead (later VCA)
presets.source: Guitar Chalk setting guide + the later VCA
